Black Bean is a field crop unlocked at experience level 25.

Like all crops, it's stored in the silo.

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 110 coin.

Growing Black Bean

Black beans are grown in fields by planting another black bean plant (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 2 xp point, and takes 10 minutes to mature.

Selling Black Beans

  • Black beans can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 72 coin for 10 units.

Using black beans

Black bean is used to make the following products:


Lamb Feed Spicy Bean Doner Bean Dip
x4 x3 x3
Level 25 Level 32 Level 54
Bean Salad Spicy Bean Taco
x3 x2
Level 58 Level 77

Boat orders

  • Boat orders ask for:
    • ?? to 41 black beans per crate, up to a total of 148 per boat.
